001package org.clafer.ontology;
002
003import java.util.Collection;
004import java.util.Collections;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.HashSet;
007import java.util.Iterator;
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Map;
010import java.util.Map.Entry;
011import java.util.Objects;
012import java.util.Set;
013import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
014import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
015import org.clafer.graph.GraphUtil;
016import org.clafer.graph.KeyGraph;
017
018/**
019 * A binary relation.
020 *
021 * @param <T> the type
022 * @author jimmy
023 */
024public class Relation<T> implements Iterable<Pair<T, T>> {
025
026    /**
027     * Contains the forward joins.
028     */
029    final Map<T, Set<T>> forwards;
030    /**
031     * Contains the backward joins.
032     */
033    final Map<T, Set<T>> backwards;
034
035    public Relation() {
036        this(new HashMap<>(), new HashMap<>());
037    }
038
039    public Relation(Relation<T> copy) {
040        this(new HashMap<>(copy.forwards), new HashMap<>(copy.backwards));
041    }
042
043    Relation(Map<T, Set<T>> forwards, Map<T, Set<T>> backwards) {
044        this.forwards = forwards;
045        this.backwards = backwards;
046    }
047
048    public void add(T a, T b) {
049        Set<T> bs = forwards.get(a);
050        if (bs == null) {
051            bs = new HashSet<>();
052            forwards.put(a, bs);
053        }
054        bs.add(b);
055
056        Set<T> as = backwards.get(b);
057        if (as == null) {
058            as = new HashSet<>();
059            backwards.put(b, as);
060        }
061        as.add(a);
062    }
063
064    public void addAll(T a, Collection<T> b) {
065        Set<T> bs = forwards.get(a);
066        if (bs == null) {
067            bs = new HashSet<>();
068            forwards.put(a, bs);
069        }
070        bs.addAll(b);
071
072        for (T t : b) {
073            Set<T> as = backwards.get(t);
074            if (as == null) {
075                as = new HashSet<>();
076                backwards.put(t, as);
077            }
078            as.add(a);
079        }
080    }
081
082    public void set(Relation<T> relation) {
083        forwards.clear();
084        forwards.putAll(relation.forwards);
085        backwards.clear();
086        backwards.putAll(relation.backwards);
087    }
088
089    public boolean has(T a, T b) {
090        Set<T> bs = forwards.get(a);
091        return bs != null && bs.contains(b);
092    }
093
094    public Set<T> from(T a) {
095        Set<T> bs = forwards.get(a);
096        return bs == null ? Collections.emptySet() : bs;
097    }
098
099    public Set<T> to(T b) {
100        Set<T> as = backwards.get(b);
101        return as == null ? Collections.emptySet() : as;
102    }
103
104    public Relation<T> compose(Relation<T> with) {
105        Relation<T> composition = new Relation<>();
106        for (Entry<T, Set<T>> entry : entrySet()) {
107            T sub = entry.getKey();
108            Set<T> sups = entry.getValue();
109            for (T sup : sups) {
110                composition.addAll(sub, with.from(sup));
111            }
112        }
113        return composition;
114    }
115
116    public Relation<T> inverse() {
117        return new Relation<>(new HashMap<>(backwards), new HashMap<>(forwards));
118    }
119
120    public void closeTransitively() {
121        // Naive algorithm.
122        for (Entry<T, Set<T>> forward : forwards.entrySet()) {
123            Set<T> reachable = new HashSet<>(forward.getValue().size());
124            reachable(forward.getKey(), reachable);
125            forward.setValue(reachable);
126        }
127    }
128
129    private void reachable(T from, Set<T> reachable) {
130        Set<T> tos = forwards.get(from);
131        if (tos != null) {
132            for (T to : tos) {
133                if (reachable.add(to)) {
134                    reachable(to, reachable);
135                }
136            }
137        }
138    }
139
140    public Relation<T> transitiveClosureWithoutCycles() {
141        KeyGraph<T> graph = new KeyGraph<>();
142        forEach(graph::addEdge);
143        List<Set<T>> items = GraphUtil.computeStronglyConnectedComponents(graph);
144        for (Set<T> cycle : items) {
145            if (cycle.size() > 1) {
146                throw new IllegalStateException("Found a cycle in the relationship: " + cycle);
147            }
148        }
149        Map<T, Set<T>> newForwards = new HashMap<>(forwards);
150        Map<T, Set<T>> newBackwards = new HashMap<>(backwards);
151        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
152            Map<T, Set<T>> map = i == 0 ? newForwards : newBackwards;
153            for (Set<T> item : items) {
154                for (T from : item) {
155                    Set<T> newTos = new HashSet<>();
156                    newTos.add(from);
157                    Set<T> tos = map.get(from);
158                    if (tos != null) {
159                        newTos.addAll(tos);
160                        tos.stream().map(map::get)
161                                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
162                                .forEach(newTos::addAll);
163                    }
164                    map.put(from, newTos);
165                }
166            }
167        }
168        return new Relation<>(newForwards, newBackwards);
169    }
170
171    public void removeSymmetry() {
172        for (Entry<T, Set<T>> forward : forwards.entrySet()) {
173            forward.getValue().remove(forward.getKey());
174        }
175        for (Entry<T, Set<T>> backward : backwards.entrySet()) {
176            backward.getValue().remove(backward.getKey());
177        }
178    }
179
180    public Set<Entry<T, Set<T>>> entrySet() {
181        return forwards.entrySet();
182    }
183
184    public void forEach(BiConsumer<T, T> action) {
185        forwards.forEach((x, y) -> y.forEach(z -> action.accept(x, z)));
186    }
187
188    @Override
189    public Iterator<Pair<T, T>> iterator() {
190        return forwards.entrySet().stream()
191                .flatMap(x -> x.getValue().stream().map(y -> new Pair<>(x.getKey(), y)))
192                .iterator();
193    }
194}
